description_zh: 调用DeletePhysicalConnection接口删除物理专线连接
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-physical-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-119mfjzm7000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeletePhysicalConnection

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect circuit
parameters.name: physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
